correctness.rationale: The graph is the path u-w-v with a,b nonempty leaf blocks; deleting w is a join of two star higher-independence complexes, each a wedge of binom(a-1,r-1) spheres dimension r-1 (or contractible). The link for r>=2 is Ind_{r-1}(the adjacent-hub double-star), computed by coning off skeletons and is wedge of binom(a+b-1,r-3) spheres dimension r-2 (or contractible). The deletion is (2r-2)-connected or contractible, hence the link inclusion is null for r>=2; cofiber yields wedges in degrees r-1 and 2r-1. r=1 is join of two S0 with contractible link, yielding S1; r>=a+b+3 is a simplex. Checked proof identities directly against frozen RESULT.md and independent full mod-two face enumeration for 63 instances; no extrapolation from enumeration.
